easyPrerequisites:
Braid of Fire has an age counter on it, or Obeka's power is 3 or greater.
You and an opponent each control a creature.
description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Obeka. Obeka triggers, causing you to get that many upkeep steps after this one.
Move to your first extra upkeep. At the beginning of that upkeep, Braid of Fire triggers, putting an age counter on it and adding {R} for each age counter on it.
Repeat step 2 for each other upkeep step.
During your postcombat main phase, activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
